map "https://fhir.demo.smartregister.org/fhir/StructureMap/unicef-mexico-child-registration" = 'Child Registration'

uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/QuestionnaireReponse" as source
uses "http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient" as target

group ChildRegistration(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src -> bundle.id = uuid() "r_bundle_id";
    src -> bundle.type = 'collection' "r_bundle_type";

    //Consent given
    src.item as item where(linkId = "43f08bd6-f987-4f12-8dca-11a89a0af1e3" and answer.value.code = "373066001" ) then {
        src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Patient') as child then {
            src then ExtractChildPatient(src, child, bundle), 
            ExtractEncounter(src,child, bundle), 
            ExtractConsent(src, child, bundle) "r_extract_consent";
        } "r_extract_child_patient";
    } "r_cons_yes";

    //No consent given
    src.item as item where(linkId = "43f08bd6-f987-4f12-8dca-11a89a0af1e3" and answer.value.code = "373067005" ) then {
        src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create("Consent") as cns then {
            src -> cns.id = uuid()  "r_cns_id";
            src -> cns.status = "rejected" "r_status_active";
            src -> cns.scope = cc("http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/consent-scope", "patient-privacy", "Privacy Consent"),
                cns.dateTime = evaluate(src, now()) "r_date_created";
            src -> cns.performer = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_cns_performer";
            src -> cns.organization = create('Reference') as orgRef then {
                src -> orgRef.reference = evaluate(src, 'Organization/' + $this.managingOrganization) "org";
            } "r_cns_org";
            src -> cns.source = create('Reference') as consentSource then {
                src -> consentSource.reference = evaluate(src, 'QuestionnaireResponse/' + src.id) "source";
            } "r_cns_source";
        } "r_cns_item";
    } "r_cons_no";
}

group ExtractConsent(source src : QuestionnaireResponse, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src.item as item where(linkId = "43f08bd6-f987-4f12-8dca-11a89a0af1e3") then {
        src -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create("Consent") as cns then {
            src -> cns.id = uuid()  "r_cns_id";
            src -> cns.status = "active" "r_status_active";
            src -> cns.scope = cc("http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/consent-scope", "patient-privacy", "Privacy Consent"),
                cns.dateTime = evaluate(src, now()) "r_date_created";
            src -> cns.patient = reference(patient) "r_cns_patient";
            src -> cns.performer = evaluate(src, $this.generalPractitioner.first()) "r_cns_performer";
            src -> cns.organization = create('Reference') as orgRef then {
                src -> orgRef.reference = evaluate(src, 'Organization/' + $this.managingOrganization) "org";
            } "r_cns_org";
            src -> cns.source = create('Reference') as consentSource then {
                src -> consentSource.reference = evaluate(src, 'QuestionnaireResponse/' + src.id) "source";
            } "r_cns_source";
        } "r_cns_item";
    } "r_consent";
}

group ExtractChildPatient(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, target childPatient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
        src -> childPatient.id = uuid() "r_patient_id";
        src -> childPatient.identifier = create('Identifier') as childId1 then {
            src -> childId1.value = 'Child' "rule_child_identifier_1_nrc_value";
            src -> childId1.use = "usual" "rule_child_identifier_1_nrc_use";
        } "rule_identifier_1";
        src -> childPatient.identifier = create('Identifier') as childId2 then {
            src -> childId2.value = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'child-id').answer.value) "rule_child_identifier_2_nrc_value";
            src -> childId2.use = "official" "rule_child_identifier_2_nrc_use";
        } "rule_identifier_2";
        src -> childPatient.active = true "r_patient_active";
        src -> childPatient.name = create('HumanName') as childName then {
            src -> childName.given = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'child-name').answer.value) "rule_patient_given_name";
            src -> childName.use = 'official' "rule_patient_name_use";
        } "rule_patient_name";
        src -> childPatient.gender = evaluate(src, $this.item.where(linkId = 'sex').answer.value.code) "rule_patient_gender";
        src.item as childPatient_dob where(linkId = 'date-of-birth') then {
            childPatient_dob.answer first as childBirthDateAnswer then {
                childBirthDateAnswer.value as val -> childPatient.birthDate = val "rule_patient_dob_answer";
            } "rule__first_patient_dob";
        } "rule_patient_dob";
        // Years or Months or Weeks shall be converted to days in the Questionnaire
        src.item as child_age where(linkId = 'age-in-days' and answer.value.toInteger() > 0) -> childPatient.birthDate = evaluate(child_age, today() - ($this.answer.value.toString() + " days").toQuantity()) "rule_patient_age";
        src.item as nationality_details where(linkId = 'nationality-details') then {
            src -> childPatient.address = create('Address') as childAddress then {
                src -> childAddress.country = evaluate(nationality_details, $this.item.where(linkId ='nationality').answer.value.display) "rule_patient_address_country";
                src -> childAddress.country = evaluate(nationality_details, $this.item.where(linkId ='specific-nationality').answer.value.display) "rule_patient_address_specific";
                src -> childAddress.state = evaluate(nationality_details, $this.item.where(linkId ='state').answer.value.display) "rule_patient_address_state";
                src -> childAddress.use = "home" "r_address_use";
                src -> childAddress.type = "physical" "r_address_type";
            } "rule_address";   
        } "rule_nationality_details";

        // The Caregiver will be the Child's Related Person (Child.link = RelatedPerson)
         src.item as caregiver where(linkId = 'caregiver-id' and answer.value.exists()) then {
            caregiver -> bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('RelatedPerson') as relatedPerson then {
                src then ExtractRelatedPerson(src, childPatient, relatedPerson) "rule_extract_related_person";
                src -> childPatient.link = create("Patient_Link") as patientLink then {
                    src -> patientLink.other = reference(relatedPerson) "r_child_p_link";
                     src -> patientLink.type = "seealso" "r_code_type";
                } "r_patient_link";
            } "rule_related_person";
        } "rule_caregiver";
}

 group ExtractRelatedPerson(source src : QuestionnaireResponse, source child : Patient, target relatedPerson : RelatedPerson) {
      child -> relatedPerson.id = uuid() "rule_related_person";
      child -> relatedPerson.identifier = create('Identifier') as relatedPersonIdentifier then {
           child -> relatedPersonIdentifier.value = uuid() "rule_related_person_identifier_value";
           child -> relatedPersonIdentifier.use = "secondary" "rule_related_person_identifier_use";
      } "rule_related_person_identifier";
      child -> relatedPerson.active = true "rule_related_person_active";
      child -> relatedPerson.relationship = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
                 child -> concept.coding = c("https://smartregister.org/", "Caregiver") as coding then {
                 child -> coding.display = 'Caregiver' "r_en_cod_disp";
             } "r_en_cc_cod";
      } "rule_related_person_relationship";
      child -> relatedPerson.patient = create('Reference') as ref then {
           child -> ref.reference = evaluate(src, 'Patient/' + $this.item.where(linkId = 'caregiver-id').answer.value) "rule_related_person_patient_ref";
      } "rule_related_person_patient";
 }

group ExtractEncounter(source src: QuestionnaireResponse, source patient: Patient, target bundle: Bundle) {
    src ->  bundle.entry as entry, entry.resource = create('Encounter') as encounter then {
        src -> encounter.id = uuid() "r_en_id";
        src -> encounter.status = 'finished' "r_en_st";
        src -> encounter.class = c("http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActCode", "HH") "r_en_cls";
        src -> encounter.subject = reference(patient) "r_en_sub";
        src -> encounter.type = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "http://snomed.info/sct" "r_p_coding_system";
                src -> coding.code = "307782001" "r_p_coding_code";
                src -> coding.display = "Child Patient Registration" "r_p_coding_display";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
            src -> concept.text = "Child Patient Registration" "r_en_typ_text";
        } "r_en_typ";
        src -> encounter.priority = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-ActPriority" "r_p_coding_system";
                src -> coding.code = "EL" "r_p_coding_code";
                src -> coding.display = "elective" "r_p_coding_display";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
            src -> concept.text = 'elective' "r_en_prio_text";
        } "r_en_prio";
        src -> encounter.period = create('Period') as enPeriod then {
            src -> enPeriod.start = evaluate(src, now()) "r_en_per_start";
            src -> enPeriod.end = evaluate(src, now()) "r_en_per_end";
        } "r_en_per";
        src -> encounter.reasonCode = create('CodeableConcept') as concept then {
            src -> concept.coding = create("Coding") as coding then {
                src -> coding.system = "http://smartregsiter.org/" "r_p_coding_system";
                src -> coding.code = "child_patient_registration" "r_p_coding_code";
                src -> coding.display = "Child Patient Registration" "r_p_coding_display";
            } "r_p_meta_coding";
            src -> concept.text = 'Child Patient Registration' "r_en_text";
        } "r_en_reason";
    } "r_encounter";
}
